annotations.title: Check a list of trip stops against a user’s history (cache)

description: Plan a brewery/bar crawl in ONE call: for each place (venue_id, name + city/state, lat/lng, and/or brewery_id) return whether the user has been there (dates, total visits, matched venues incl. "(duplicate of …)" copies — from the cached venue history, run untappd_sync_user_venues first), and for a brewery_id: how many of its beers they have had and the top 4 (top_n) NOT-had beers by Untappd global rating, optionally filtered by style (out-of-production beers skipped unless include_out_of_production). Has-had and visits come from the cache ONLY; the only API calls are brewery/beer_list fetches for a brewery whose list is not cached or is past its 7-day TTL, at most api_budget (default 5; 0 = strictly cache-only, a stale list is then used and flagged) under the ~100 calls/hour guard — a missing list sets another_run_needed. Beer lists are global facts: Untappd's have_had on that endpoint is the AUTHENTICATED account's and is never used. Favorites (breweries liked on Untappd via untappd_sync_brewery_likes, derived from the cached history, or added with untappd_favorite_add) are flagged on matched venues, the brewery and beers; prefer_favorites (default true) lifts wishlisted beers (+0.5) and a favorite brewery's beers (+0.25); and a stop within near_favorite_radius_m (default 2000 m) of a favorite venue gets near_favorites + a "Near a favorite" hint. For a GROUP pass usernames + mode ("none_had" default / "any_not_had"). Returns has-had and venue freshness blocks.

api_budget.description: Max brewery/beer_list calls for missing or stale lists (default 5; 0 = cache only)

include_out_of_production.description: Also rank beers Untappd marks out of production (default false)

max_matches.description: Most matched venues listed per user per stop (default 5)

mode.description: With usernames: "none_had" (default) lists beers new to everyone; "any_not_had" beers someone still needs

near_favorite_radius_m.description: Radius for the "near a favorite" hint in metres (default 2000)

places.description: The stops (1–25); each needs venue_id, name, lat+lng, or brewery_id

brewery_id.description: Untappd brewery id: adds beers-had and the top not-had beers from the brewery's (cached) beer list

city.description: Narrow a name match to venues whose city contains this

label.description: Your own label for this stop, echoed back

lat.description: Latitude of the stop; needs lng

lng.description: Longitude of the stop; needs lat

name.description: Venue name (case-insensitive substring or every significant word); defaults to the brewery name for a brewery_id stop

radius_m.description: Visit-match radius around lat/lng in metres (default 150)

state.description: Narrow a name match to venues whose state contains this (e.g. "FL")

venue_id.description: Untappd venue id of the stop

prefer_favorites.description: Boost wishlisted beers (+0.5) and favorite-brewery beers (+0.25) (default true)

style.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on the beer style (e.g. "ipa")

top_n.description: Not-had beers listed per brewery stop (default 4)

username.description: Untappd username. Omit to use your own configured account (UNTAPPD_USERNAME).

usernames.description: Check a GROUP (1–10) instead of one user; use instead of username

name: untappd_trip_check
title: Check a list of trip stops against a user’s history (cache)
